summary: This Phase 4 study looked at using the drug Atorvastatin to treat abnormal blood fat levels, known as dyslipidemia, in children with a kidney condition called steroid sensitive nephrotic syndrome. The trial included 100 participants. It was sponsored by the National Institute of Kidney Disease and Urology (NIKDU) and has now been completed.

facts.sponsor: National Institute of Kidney Disease and Urology (NIKDU)
